name: Foldable Wireless On-Ear Headphones — P47
description: Foldable wireless on-ear headphones with a padded headband and ear cups. Playback buttons on the right cup. Comes with a retail box. Colours: lime green, blue, white, black and red.

source.notes: Style "P47 complete set boxed", ¥9.30 (a second ¥6.70 figure shows, not used). Rate 223.9 ₦/¥ (listing header). Shop confirmed as Huixun by the style picker. Owner set the price (₦17000). Awaiting sharper supplier photos (owner: hold until they arrive). "P47 wireless" is printed on the band and box: a model name, not a brand. Box reads 5.0+EDR (supplier print, not claimed in copy). Photos are 750 px desk shots cropped 600x750 to 4:5 and enlarged 2x: SOFT. Book spine with third-party text cropped out; the retail box stays in shot. Plant edge visible on the right. Very common cheap model; store has no on-ear headphones (over-ear ANC ones at ₦55-66k are a different tier). Do not call it ANC. Owner sent photos with no message; shop, listing, style name and ¥ price unknown. Likely the Shenzhen Huixun listing (offerId 1025659251706, 58.6% return rate) but unconfirmed: if so, samples first and stay unpublished. Lithium battery: sea freight only. No battery, playtime or waterproofing claimed.

supplier.name: Shenzhen Huixun Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
